thread:
maria: Quick sync — Aster tenant private rollout is scheduled for 08:00 PT tomorrow. Final checklist: networking, certs, air-gap image sync, and on-prem ops handoff. Who can take ownership of the last-mile NAT / firewall rules?

raj: I can own NAT + firewall. Will validate rules against their NOC CIDR later today.

lee: I will take cert rotation and KMS key policy review. ETA 18:00 PT. Need the exact subjectAltName list from Aster.

maria: thx both. @raj please confirm if we need a static egress IP or can use the nat-gw pool. Aster asked for locked-down egress.

raj: they asked for a single egress IP. We can allocate one from the pool but need cloud infra signoff for reserved elastic. pinging @tom.

tom: I can approve reservation for a single IP for the window. Need the requested IP label and time window. I'll add a CR.

kelly: On ops side — image sync to the airgapped registry is at 02:00 PT. We've had one flaky attempt last week due to proxy auth. I put a retry and checksum verification in the runbook.

maria: can you paste the checksum step here? want to include in the customer handoff doc.

kelly: ```bash
# after scp to bastion
sha256sum /var/registry/images/redwood-serve:release-2026-03 > /tmp/aster.sha256
# on customer side verify
sha256sum -c /tmp/aster.sha256
```

raj: quick question on firewall rules: should we open TCP 22 to their bastion or only to our deploy host? security requested minimal access.

lee: Prefer only to our deploy host (10.12.8.45). We'll run SSH jump from that host. Add a rule comment with ticket ID.

maria: noted — ticket #PRIV-4821. @deploy-bot can you confirm the canary deploy job is wired to the private VPC cluster and not the staging shared pool?

deploy-bot: Canary job "aster-private-canary" set to cluster id: pv-cluster-07. Trigger schedule: manual. Verified: no shared-pool tasks. :white_check_mark:

maria: Perfect. Two open items: 1) reserved egress IP allocation (tom + raj) 2) final ops runbook sign-off after checksum step (kelly + maria). Can each owner drop a ✅ in thread when complete?

raj: ✅ I filed the elastic IP CR and assigned to pv-cluster-07 (CR-3247).

tom: ✅ Reserved IP allocated for the window. Will release after 12 hours post-cutover.

kelly: Doing final image sync now, verification running. Will post checksum result in 15m.

lee: Cert policy reviewed. Added SANs: aster.ops.redwood.local, aster-api.internal. No blockers. ✅

ops-bot: Image transfer completed. Checksums match: 2 files verified. Logs: s3://private-sync/aster/2026-03-17/transfer.log

kelly: ✅ Sync & checksum OK. Pull test on customer side succeeded (exit 0). Updating runbook.

maria: Amazing — looks like we can proceed. Final reminder: handoff call in #private-deploy-handshake at 07:15 PT for the oncall rotation and rollback plan. If anything new pops up, post here. Thanks everyone :rocket:

raj: Leaving a note: if the NAT gateway quota change blocks the IP reservation, ping infra and escalate to infra-owners@redwood-infra.

maria: Adding that to runbook. Thread closed after cutover unless someone needs to reopen.

kelly: will follow up post-cutover with smoke report.

tom: Good luck team — I will be on standby for release window.
